title: Collections Desk Note: Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan Credit When an Agreement Ends by Lien Sale or Tow
content:
When the agreement covered by a Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan ends by lien sale or tow, the unused prepaid credit is applied to the balance owed on that agreement and any remainder is refunded to the former tenant. Because the plan pays every due date in its term, an agreement under an active plan can fall behind only on fees or charges outside the plan.

## The rule in parts

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Event | The covered agreement ends by lien sale or tow |
| What is applied | The plan's unused prepaid credit — prepaid rent not yet applied to a month |
| Applied to | The balance owed on that same agreement |
| Remainder | Refunded to the former tenant |
| Plan status | Moves from active to forfeited |

## What can be owed on a covered agreement

Rent for each due date in the term is paid by the plan. Any balance owed on an agreement under an active plan can therefore consist only of fees or charges outside the plan, not of rent for a due date in the term.

## Worked cases (hypothetical amounts)

| Unused prepaid credit | Balance owed on the agreement | Applied to the balance | Refunded to the former tenant |
|---|---|---|---|
| $600.00 | $180.00 | $180.00 | $420.00 |
| $250.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 | $0.00 |
| $100.00 | $250.00 | $100.00 | $0.00 — no credit remains |

The credit of one plan goes only to the balance of the agreement that plan covers; a balance on another agreement of the same tenant is not the object of this application.
